name: B3·4 Intelligence & Backup — weekly market watch + monthly AI business review + daily backup (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Variables: **GEMINI_API_KEY, TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME**. Attach Telegram + Sheets + Drive credentials.
2. Replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID (your master spreadsheet) and REPLACE_BACKUP_FOLDER_ID (a Drive folder named 'Backups').
3. That's it — three timers, zero webhooks.

## HOW IT RUNS
• **Mon 08:00 — Market watch:** Gemini briefs you on gold price direction, jewellery retail news and one competitor tactic to copy this week.
• **1st of month 08:00 — AI business review:** reads your whole Enquiries tab → Gemini writes a plain-language monthly review (what grew, best source, conversion, 3 concrete actions) → Telegram.
• **Daily 23:30 — Backup:** copies the master spreadsheet into the Backups folder with the date in the name. 30 seconds of insurance for your whole business data.

## 🔧 FIX
• Review too generic → keep Item/Source/Amount columns filled; more data = sharper review.
• Backup duplicates → that's intended (one per day); prune old ones monthly.
• Want the review as PDF/email? Chain a Gmail node after 'Telegram: monthly review'.
